introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Cycle-life testing of new lithium-ion cells and fast-charging protocols takes months, so predicting cycle life from the first 100 cycles would shorten battery development.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: On the evaluated 124-cell fast-charging dataset, early-cycle models give point predictions without calibrated uncertainty, and their errors grow on cells charged with protocols absent from training.
search_directions: Find reviews of lithium-ion battery remaining useful life and cycle-life prediction methods published in energy and power-source journals
Find highly cited papers on lithium-ion battery degradation mechanisms and the cost and duration of cycle-life testing
Identify foundational data-driven battery prognostics papers (2010-2020) on capacity fade and state-of-health forecasting

related_work_strategy.overview: Contrast early-cycle feature models with sequence and probabilistic models of capacity fade, to motivate a constrained tree model with calibrated intervals.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Hand-crafted features from early charge and discharge cycles with linear or tree-based regressors
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find 2019-2025 journal papers that predict battery cycle life or remaining useful life from the first 100 cycles or fewer, and the datasets they use.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: They give point predictions without calibrated uncertainty, and their accuracy drops on cells charged with protocols not seen in training.
limitation_search_queries: early cycle life prediction lithium-ion battery generalization to unseen charging protocols
battery cycle life prediction uncertainty quantification prediction intervals
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Our monotone gradient-boosted model adds split-conformal prediction intervals whose coverage we measure on seen and unseen protocols.

subsections.subsection_title: 2.2 Sequence and probabilistic models of capacity fade
subsections.methodology_cluster: Recurrent neural networks and Gaussian processes that extrapolate capacity-fade curves
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find journal papers that use LSTM networks or Gaussian process regression to forecast capacity fade and remaining useful life of lithium-ion batteries.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: They need long capacity histories and extrapolate poorly from the first 100 cycles, before capacity fade is visible.
limitation_search_queries: LSTM remaining useful life prediction lithium-ion battery capacity degradation
Gaussian process regression battery capacity fade extrapolation from early cycles
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Our model uses discharge voltage-curve features that change before capacity fades, instead of extrapolating the capacity curve.
